g.text: Data residency: what crosses the AU and NZ border
Pick the inference profile, then enforce it with IAM and an SCP.
NZ data on au. can be
Rest of the world · global. profile
any supported commercial Region, e.g. Tokyo, Singapore, US
Check the real destination list: aws bedrock get-inference-profile --inference-profile-identifier au.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
NZ data on au. can be processed in Australia. In-region keeps it in one Region, if the model is offered there.
Enforce with an IAM condition on bedrock:InferenceProfileArn plus an SCP. Residency is about location; sovereignty (whose law applies) is a question for legal.
